integrity: Mathematical proof and directly rerunnable finite-cell certificate included. Literature statements attributed, with no claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Full rational characters and ordinary rational orbit-quotient homology only; no integral quotient classification, homotopy type, or complete irreducible-decomposition table; potential unindexed equivalent work remains. Rational boundary rank follows jointly from a modular lower bound and cycle-lifting upper bound. The finite checker does not independently prove the general graph-configuration suitable-subdivision theorem or rational transfer theorem.
title: The full 96-symmetry rational homology character of two particles on the Möbius–Kantor graph
